label: Acyclic grounding and occupant coverage imply the same-recipient root or regress
description: Apply the generic source_or_regress from WORLD-ACTUAL-SOURCE-OR-REGRESS to ConcreteExistentialSupply.graph, reusing the selected existential-grounding relation without assuming efficient causation. Coverage supplies a concrete predecessor to any occupied source, so every source reached by the classification is unlocated. If the recipient is located then a path to the unlocated root has positive length. The successor control verifies occupant N2 and coverage with an acyclic injective regress generated by a single relation rule. The field/mode control verifies occupant N2, a genuine mode ground, and no anchored regress at the mode. Coverage fails at the actual concrete located field. The controls establish formal consistency of these bundles under the given interpretations. The existential-grounding applicability and actual coverage of occupants remain open.
